snippet.title: Smok
snippet.description:
Having Coffee with Smok is about programming, software developing. I make videos on both: serious technical problems and life & work situations that everyone in this field encounters. I try to explain things I've learned and demystify the craft of the software engineer. Hope you have a great time here!

Hit me up with great topics you want to see on this channel as well as all the feedback you have.

Cheers!
Rafal Swidzinski
